groups.title: End-to-End Testing with Playwright
groups.question: You are setting up end-to-end tests for your Astro site across several browsers. Explain how you would configure Playwright and organise tests.

followUps.Page Object Model Pattern: How does the page object model help?

evidence.text: It defines which browsers to test.
It sets the base URL and timeouts.
Keeping these in config avoids hard-coding them in tests.
Page objects wrap selectors and actions for each page.
Tests do not depend directly on the DOM structure.
UI changes only require updating the page object.

groups.title: Testing Strategy
groups.question: A redesign accidentally broke your site's navigation for screen readers and changed the footer layout without anyone noticing. Explain how tests could have caught both.

followUps.Accessibility Testing in Playwright: How do role-based locators double as accessibility checks?
followUps.Visual Regression Testing: How does visual regression testing work?

evidence.text: getByRole and getByLabel find elements by their accessible role and name.
If they cannot find an element, it is often not accessible.
They also survive changes to CSS classes.
Tests capture screenshots of pages or components.
They compare them with approved baselines.
Differences above a threshold fail the test so changes are reviewed.

groups.title: Deployment with Netlify
groups.question: You are deploying your Astro site with server-rendered pages to Netlify, and reviewers want to see changes before merge. Explain the setup.

followUps.Netlify Adapter and Build Config: What does the Netlify adapter produce?
followUps.Continuous Deployment and Preview Deploy: What do preview deploys give the team?

evidence.text: It turns server-rendered pages and endpoints into Netlify Functions.
Middleware can run as Edge Functions.
The build command and publish folder are set for Netlify.

notEnough: Only saying it deploys to Netlify.

evidence.text: Every pull request gets its own preview URL.
Changes are reviewed in a production-like environment.
Problems are caught before merging.

groups.title: CI/CD Integration
groups.question: You want every pull request tested automatically, and the build needs API keys. Explain how you would set up GitHub Actions and secrets.

followUps.GitHub Actions for Astro: What should the GitHub Actions workflow do?
followUps.Environment Variable Management in CI: How should secrets be provided in CI?

evidence.text: It installs dependencies and builds the site.
It runs Playwright tests against the built site.
Failing tests block merging.
Secrets are stored as repository or organisation secrets.
They are never committed to the code.
Only values meant for the browser get the PUBLIC_ prefix.
